title: Production and characterization of cell-penetrating recombinant botulinum neurotoxin type A
author: Wei, Hu, et al.
materials: This step describes how to analyze the cell-penetrating activity of CPP-BoNTA by immunofluorescence staining and confocal imaging in mouse neuroblastoma N2a cells (Figure 6).17.Mouse CPP-BoNTA, fix N2a cells with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 25°C for 15 min.18.Permeabilization of N2a cells.a.Treat cells with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 for 10 min.b.Wash cells three times with steps.title: Ni-NTA Affinity Purification
steps.instruction: Purify recombinant CPP‑BoNTA from bacterial lysate using Ni‑NTA agarose beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in 50–100 mL Ni‑Lysis buffer and sonicate at 70 % power, two cycles of 5 min (5 s on/5 s off).
Centrifuge the lysate at 16,000 g for 30 min at 4 °C; if supernatant is not clear, repeat centrifugation.
Equilibrate Ni‑NTA beads with 5 column volumes (CV) of Ni‑Lysis buffer, then add 2 mL Ni‑NTA agarose beads (50 % slurry, 1 mL settled volume) to the supernatant and rotate 1–3 h at 4 °C.
Transfer the bead slurry into a column and wash sequentially with 50 mL Ni‑Wash buffer I, then 50 mL Ni‑Wash buffer II.
Collect the flow‑through from each wash and concentrate to ~3 mL using a 50 kDa MWCO spin concentrator at 4 °C.
Wash the beads with 50 mL Ni‑Wash buffer III and again concentrate the flow‑through to ~3 mL with the same concentrator.
Elute bound protein with 50 mL Ni‑elution buffer, then concentrate the eluate to ~3 mL using the 50 kDa MWCO spin concentrator at 4 °C.

steps.title: Size-Exclusion Chromatography
steps.instruction: Further purify the Ni‑NTA eluate by SEC on a Superdex 200 column.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate a Superdex 200 10/300 GL column with 1.5 CV of SEC buffer.
Load 500 µL of the concentrated Ni‑NTA eluate onto the column.
Collect fractions corresponding to the target protein peaks as indicated by UV absorbance.
Aliquot purified protein and store at –80 °C (stable for up to one year).

steps.title: SDS-PAGE and Coomassie Staining
steps.instruction: Assess purity of purified CPP‑BoNTA by SDS‑PAGE followed by Coomassie staining.

substeps.instruction: Place the pre‑cast GenScript gel in the electrophoresis tank and add 1× MOPS SDS running buffer.
Remove the comb, load 10 µL of each protein sample into wells.
Run the gel at 200 V for ~30 min.
Stain the gel with Coomassie blue staining buffer for 20 min.
Destain with destaining buffer for ~40 min until clear bands appear.

steps.title: Culture and Treat N2a Cells
steps.instruction: Grow N2a cells on poly‑L‑lysine‑coated coverslips and incubate with CPP‑BoNTA.

substeps.instruction: Maintain N2a cells in MEM EARLES supplemented with 10 % FBS, 1 % MEM NEAA, and 100 U/mL penicillin/streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Coat 12 mm coverslips with 500 µL poly‑L‑lysine (1:10 dilution in water) for 1 h at 25 °C in a 24‑well plate.
Wash coverslips three times with sterile PBS and air‑dry at 4 °C for 12–16 h.
Seed cells onto the coated coverslips and incubate 2 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 70–80 % confluent.
Add 100 nM CPP‑BoNTA to the medium, incubate 4 h, then fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) at 25 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Cell Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize fixed N2a cells for antibody access.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells with PBS containing 0.1 % Triton X‑100 for 10 min.
Wash three times with PBS containing 0.2 % BSA.

steps.title: Block Non‑Specific Binding (Cells)
steps.instruction: Block remaining binding sites before antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate coverslips in PBS with 0.2 % BSA at 25 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Staining (Cells)
steps.instruction: Label CPP‑BoNTA and SV2A with primary antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mixture of goat anti‑FLAG (Novus) and rabbit anti‑SV2A (Novus) at 1:200 dilution in PBS + 0.2 % BSA.
Cover the plate and incubate at 25 °C for 1–2 h.
Wash coverslips 5 times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA, then 5 times with PBS, then again 5 times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Staining (Cells)
steps.instruction: Apply fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibodies to visualize primary binding.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Alexa568‑donkey anti‑rabbit IgG and Alexa488‑donkey anti‑goat IgG in PBS + 0.2 % BSA.
Incubate coverslips at 25 °C for 45 min in the dark.
Wash 5 times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA, then 5 times with PBS, then 5 times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA.
Note: keep slides in the dark thereafter; they can be stored at –80 °C for up to three months.
Incubate coverslips with Hoechst 33342 (Invitrogen) for 5–10 min at 25 °C.
Wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Mount Coverslips for Imaging
steps.instruction: Mount stained coverslips on slides with antifade reagent.

substeps.instruction: Place coverslips onto microscope slides containing ProLong Gold antifade reagent.
Allow slides to dry at 25 °C in the dark for 12–16 h.
Store slides at 4 °C for long‑term use.

steps.title: Confocal Imaging and Quantification (Cells)
steps.instruction: Acquire and analyze fluorescence images of N2a cells.

substeps.instruction: Image slides on a Zeiss LSM710 laser‑scanning confocal microscope using excitation/emission filters 493 nm/598 nm (red) and 410 nm/507 nm (green).
Measure fluorescence intensity per cell with ZEN 2011 software; background subtraction can be performed in FIJI.

steps.title: TissueFAXS Cytometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Quantify fluorescence of mounted cell samples using the TissueFAXS system.

substeps.instruction: Load the prepared coverslip slides (from step 10) onto the TissueFAXS (TissueGnostics) fluorescence imaging system.
Scan entire sections and calculate fluorescence intensity with TissueQuest software.

steps.title: Prepare Gastrocnemius Muscle Sections
steps.instruction: Collect and embed mouse gastrocnemius muscle for immunofluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Section fresh gastrocnemius muscle into small pieces.
Fix pieces immediately in 4 % PFA at 25 °C for 10 min.
Dehydrate in 30 % sucrose for 12–16 h.
Blot dry with paper towels and place tissue blocks in molds.
Incubate blocks in 100 % OCT compound for a total of 4 h at –80 °C.
Freeze‑section OCT‑embedded muscle at 10 µm intervals in both transverse and longitudinal planes.

steps.title: Block Non‑Specific Binding (Tissue)
steps.instruction: Block tissue sections before antibody staining.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sections with PBS containing 5 % BSA at 25 °C for 1 h.
Wash sections five times with PBS, 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Staining (Tissue)
steps.instruction: Label tissue sections with primary antibodies against FLAG and SV2A.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sections with goat anti‑FLAG and anti‑SV2A antibodies diluted 1:200 in PBS + 0.2 % BSA at 4 °C for 12–16 h.
Wash three times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA, then three times with PBS, then three times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Staining (Tissue)
steps.instruction: Apply fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibodies to tissue sections.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sections with Alexa‑conjugated secondary antibodies diluted 1:1000 in PBS + 0.2 % BSA for 1 h at 25 °C in the dark.
Wash three times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA, then three times with PBS, then three times with PBS + 0.2 % BSA.
Keep sections protected from light thereafter.
Incubate sections with Hoechst 33342 diluted 1:5000 in PBS for 10 min at 25 °C in the dark.
Wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Mount Tissue Slides
steps.instruction: Mount stained tissue sections for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Place sections on microscope slides and add ProLong Gold antifade reagent.
Seal edges of the coverslip with a thin layer of clear nail polish.
Dry slides in the dark at 25 °C for 12–16 h and store at 4 °C (up to three months).

steps.title: Confocal Imaging and Quantification (Tissue)
steps.instruction: Acquire and analyze fluorescence images of gastrocnemius sections.

substeps.instruction: Image slides on a Zeiss LSM710 confocal microscope using the same excitation/emission settings as for cells (493 nm/598 nm red, 410 nm/507 nm green).
Measure fluorescence intensity per cell/area with ZEN 2011 software.
